'''B. J. Rordan's Collectables''' was a two-story building located in [[Verena City]]. It was brown in color, with split [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] frames and peeling paint. It was run by [[Bren-Jules Rordan]], an undercover [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent. Employed in the shop was [[Riin Raas]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] agent, [[Cor Mynus]], an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], and [[Russ Jarib]], an agent of [[Corporate Sector Intelligence]].
